title: 第082章 血肉工坊根骨融合第081章 血饮狂刀名列兵器谱
lines: “孔雀使、青玉使已死。”
月光落在一片残破庄园。
两道高大的身影似暗夜修罗，站在山峦上，静静望着下方的修罗场。
女人的哀求、孩童的哭泣、男人野兽般的嘶吼……
“他们太弱了。”一个霸道的口吻，来自身高九尺的猛汉。
“上头有令，一个月内，让那个人从这世上消失。”一旁的黑衣人道。
“尊上之意，属下明白。”
猛汉转身，微微一揖。
双眸神光爆闪，似照亮了幽暗的夜色，照亮了一个身穿黑衣，两手空空，面容古拙的中年男人。
一阵微风吹过，黑衣人已消失在原地。
中年猛汉抽出地上一柄黑石金刀，转身向下方行去。
他走入一座工坊，血腥味扑鼻而来。
“盟主。”
一名老者立即迎了上来。
“人丹研制的如何？”
“已成十五种配方，母子连心丹、双胞同体丹、七婴子母丹、百心灵窍丹……每一种皆神效非凡！”
“其中九种，已得极品人丹。”
老者毕恭毕敬道：“还请盟主耐心等待，欲炼极品人丹，非一时之功。药材、人材、血煞，缺一不可。”
“很好，继续努力。”
中年猛汉露出一抹笑容。
他要成功了！
只需服下十八种不同的极品人丹，便可凝聚十八道煞脉灵藏，成就世间难得的‘地胎’！
届时。
一部分献于上头，他也能留下属于自己的一份。
先天神我，近在眼前！
哗啦~
一颗脑袋浮出水面，而后是第二颗。
这里是一处地下石窟，空气湿润温热，透着一丝若有若无的血腥煞气。
风凌兮跟在陈孤舟身后，向岸边游去。
刚爬上地面。
她的目光立即被石壁上的痕迹吸引。
“你们家祖上的心得，寒霜六诀的后续推衍，不过全是错的。”陈孤舟淡淡道。
说话的同时。
他将一应物资丢在地上，似做好了常驻的准备。
这里是风云山庄。
他曾经闭关修炼的后山温泉下。一条世上仅剩两个人知道的密道，成了两人潜入的通道。
“你在这等着，我下去探查一番。”
content_en:
"The Peacock Envoy and the Sapphire Envoy are dead."
The moonlight falls on a dilapidated manor.
Two tall figures looked like Shura in the dark night, standing on the mountain, quietly looking at the Shura field below.
Women's pleading, children's cries, men's beastly roars...
"They are too weak." A domineering tone came from a nine-foot tall man.
"There is an order from above to make that person disappear from this world within a month." The man in black on the side said.
"Your Majesty's wishes are understood by my subordinates."
The fierce man turned around and bowed slightly.
The light in his eyes flashed, seeming to illuminate the dark night, illuminating a middle-aged man wearing black clothes, with empty hands and a clumsy face.
Phew~~
A breeze blew by, and the man in black disappeared.
The middle-aged fierce man pulled out a black stone gold knife from the ground, turned around and walked downwards.
He walked into a workshop and the smell of blood hit his nostrils.
"Alliance leader."
An old man came up immediately.
"How is the development of the human elixir going?"
"Fifteen formulas have been prepared, including the Mother-Son Heart-Connecting Pill, the Twin Body Pill, the Seven Infants-Son Mother Pill, and the Hundred Soul Ability Pills...each one is extremely effective!"
"Nine of them have obtained the best human elixir."
The old man said respectfully: "Please wait patiently, leader. If you want to refine the best human elixir, it is not a temporary effort. Medicinal materials, human materials, and blood evil are all indispensable."
"Great, keep up the good work."
The middle-aged tough man showed a smile.
He is going to succeed!
Just take eighteen different kinds of top-quality human elixirs to condense eighteen evil veins and spiritual treasures, and achieve the rare 'earth fetus' in the world!
By then.
A portion is given to God, and he is able to keep a portion for himself.
The innate God is right before my eyes!
——
Wow~
One head surfaced, then a second.
This is an underground grotto. The air is humid and warm, with a hint of bloody evil aura.
Feng Lingxi followed Chen Guyzhou and swam towards the shore.
Just climbed onto the ground.
Her eyes were immediately attracted by the marks on the stone wall.
"This is..."
"The experiences of your ancestors and the subsequent derivation of the Six Frost Techniques are all wrong." Chen Guzhou said calmly.
While talking.
He threw a bunch of supplies on the ground, as if he was ready to stay there.
This is Fengyun Villa.
Under the back mountain hot spring where he once practiced in seclusion. A secret passage known to only two people in the world became a passage for them to sneak into.
"You wait here, I'll go down and investigate."
